# Experiment DLG-EXP-007 of docs/spec/dialog.md, section 16: wire.
# Source: the capture of the wire between the vanilla client and the vanilla server. A line has the
# time in seconds, the direction, the phase, the packet id, the packet name, the length of the
# packet in bytes and the packet bytes in hexadecimal. The capture keeps at most 400 bytes of a
# packet.
# Lines that start with "# " are notes of the fixture. The other lines are the raw capture lines.
# The line numbers in these notes count the raw capture lines only.
# Line 1, registry_data of the registry minecraft:dialog, configuration phase. It lists the entries
# in this order: t:a, t:b, t:c, and the entries after t:c, which the capture cuts off.
# Lines 2 to 7, show_dialog, id 143, play phase: the VarInt after the packet id is 1, 2, 3, 5, 7
# and 6, and no more data follows. Entry n-1 of line 1 is the dialog. The VarInt 3 gives t:c.
# Lines 8 and 10, show_dialog with the VarInt 0 and one network NBT. It is an inline dialog of
# the type minecraft:notice with the title "N". Line 12 is an inline dialog of the same type with
# the after action wait_for_response.
# Lines 9, 11 and 13, clear_dialog, id 142: the packet has no field after its id.
#
